title: IN WHICH A SLIGHT GLIMPSE IS HAD OF SAN FRANCISCO
summary_hover: Fogg and his companions explore San Francisco, where they accidentally get caught in a violent election riot before catching their train to New York.
summary_detail: Phileas Fogg, Aouda, and Passepartout arrive in San Francisco. While Fogg and Aouda explore the city and head to the English consulate with Fix, they find themselves caught in the middle of a violent street brawl over the election of a justice of the peace. Fogg is confronted by a belligerent American, Colonel Stamp Proctor, before the party boards the evening train for New York.
